name: danceCams
meaning: four Scn_GetPropCamera(0x38/0x3c/0x40/0x44); read as {u16 focal; s16 pitch; s16 yaw; s16 roll; Vec3s eye} straight into Camera_StartScripted

name: eventCode
meaning: pending FAILURE code (0x4b2b4d-0x4b2bfe), no value means success. 1 = right button more than 200 ms late, 2 = wrong button inside the window, 3 = wrong button outside it or nothing pressed, 4 = Wolf out of costume, 5 = Wolf outside the ring, 6 = Wolf left the spot.

name: unk128
meaning: written 0 once by Create at 0x4b2727 and read nowhere in 0x4af4a0-0x4b3270 — dead field, the same pattern as Battery +0x138

name: beatTimeMs
meaning: timestamp of the current beat; SetState cases 2, 3 AND 4 set it to g_gameTimeMs

name: pressLateMinus250Ms
meaning: pressTimeMs - (beatTimeMs+250) (0x4b2b33 add edx,0xfa). Its two tests at 0x4b2b5f/0x4b2b6b are unreachable - the enclosing branch already requires pressLateMs <= 200, so the value is always <= -50. Dead test.

name: danceClock
meaning: round clock in g_dt units; advanced only while eventCode == 0 AND !Game_IsPaused AND !Map_IsOpen

name: cellW
meaning: spriteCross.widthMinus1*2 + 2, i.e. exactly twice the cross sprite's width (Sprite.csv +8 stores width-1)

name: cellH
meaning: spriteCross.heightMinus1 + 1, i.e. exactly the cross sprite's height

name: tambourineCount
meaning: entries in tambourineGhosts; the store is 0x4b0c30 (0x4b0c2d is the preceding load)

name: boxRemove
meaning: FILLED IN: PROPERTY_..._BOX_REMOVE (prop 0xc) — the box the escaped sheep must stand in for the teardown. 0x4b120f-0x4b1267 needs Wolf in BOX_SAF AND danceCompleted AND g_pSheepOutOfZone inside this box (0x4b125a/0x4b1260), then 0x4505 to every PrayingGhost and DespawnDanceSet
